attribution: Notable transactions are editorial summaries for narrative context. They are not a complete league transaction log.

2003-04.summary: Retooled around Garnett’s MVP peak; roster moves aimed at spacing and veteran defense for a West finals push.

2007-08.summary: Kevin Garnett traded to Boston in a blockbuster rebuild trade—franchise identity shifts toward youth and assets.

2014-15.summary: Selected Zach LaVine and traded for Andrew Wiggins as part of the Love deal return package.

2017-18.summary: Jimmy Butler acquired to pair with Towns and Wiggins; Wolves break a 14-year playoff drought.

2022-23.summary: Roster consolidation moves around the Edwards–Towns core as the team pursued playoff seeding in a crowded West.
